annotation.title_clean: National AI Strategy Committee Launched as Korea's Top-Level AI Policy Body
annotation.title_en: National AI Strategy Committee Launched as Korea's Top-Level AI Policy Body
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT), Republic of Korea
annotation.venue: Ministry of Science and ICT website (Press Releases)
annotation.summary_en: MSIT press release on the launch of Korea's presidential National AI Strategy Committee on 8 September 2025. It covers the eight subcommittees, the Korea AI Action Plan, the National AI Computing Center plan, and the approach to subordinate legislation under the AI Basic Act, effective January 2026. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Committee chaired by the President sets national AI policy and coordinates ministries, with eight subcommittees.
Korea AI Action Plan has three pillars and twelve strategic domains, with the full plan due by November.
National AI Computing Center will be a PPP aiming for 15,000+ GPUs by 2028.
AI Basic Act enforcement decree covers high-impact AI, testing and certification, transparency and impact assessment.
A grace period for administrative fines will apply in early enforcement.
